parentId.description: Parent listing UUID — the id returned on any read. Mutually exclusive with parentSlug; sending both is a 400. Must belong to the same directory. On PATCH, send `null` to detach the listing from its parent.

parentSlug.description: Parent listing slug (resolved within the same directory). Requires parentListingType whenever the parent is a different type than this listing — which, for the series/event hierarchy, is always. Prefer parentId if you have it.

parentListingType.description: Parent listing type. Defaults to this listing's type when omitted.

relationshipType.description: Relationship type to parent (e.g. series_of, brand_of, chapter_of)

geo.description:
Geographic data. **Full-replace on PATCH** — sending `{ geo: { lat: 36.17 } }` wipes every other geo key. To partially update, GET the listing first and merge: `PATCH { geo: { ...existing.geo, lat: 36.17 } }`.

**Recognized keys** (free-form JSON, but these are what the admin UI and adapters read):
- `lat`, `lng` — numbers
- `country` — ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. `US`
- `admin1` — state/region as an ISO 3166-2 fragment, e.g. `OH`. **This is the state field** — `state` and `region` are NOT read, and using them leaves the admin Location section blank.
- `city`, `streetAddress`, `postalCode`
- `timezone` — IANA, e.g. `America/New_York`

Any other key is stored and returned untouched, but nothing renders it.

canonicalFields.description: Canonical fields (queryable, indexable). Common keys: address, phone, email, website. **Full-replace on PATCH** — sending one key drops every other. Read-modify-write when partially updating.

editorialFields.description: Editorial copy. Conventional keys: description, seoTitle, seoDescription, ogImage, noindex, canonicalUrl, synonyms, audiences, pricing. **Full-replace on PATCH** — sending `{ editorialFields: { seoTitle: "X" } }` wipes the description and every other key. Admin UI handles this by GET → spread → PATCH; third-party callers must do the same when partially updating.

publishAt.description: Scheduled publish (ISO 8601). Listings with status:draft + publishAt in the past surface as published on read endpoints. Pass null to clear.

taxonomies.description: Taxonomy term assignments. Keys are taxonomy slugs; values are arrays of term slugs. Each taxonomy you list gets its assignments replaced — taxonomies you DON'T list are left alone (per-taxonomy partial-update). All slugs must exist or the whole request returns 400 with the unknown pairs (no partial writes). Use [] to clear a taxonomy.

slug.description:
New slug. Renaming **preserves the old slug as an alias**: every read that addresses this listing by the old `(listingType, slug)` keeps resolving, and answers with the new slug — so a consumer can compare the two and emit a 301 instead of serving the same listing at two live URLs. `GET .../listing-aliases` returns the whole redirect map for a directory in one call.

Renaming back to a slug this listing previously used consumes that alias rather than creating a cycle. A slug held live, or held as an alias by a **different** listing, is a 409.
